{{Quote|You're dead, Pavan. If I'd been a stormtrooper that is."<br>"Maybe. But it wouldn't have been a lonely death."<br>"Been practicing, I see."<br>"No, I've always been this good. I just didn't want to make you feel inadequate.|[[Laranth Tarak]] and [[Jax Pavan]] on Jax's quick-draw|<ref name="CNI:JT" />}}
After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] armed himself with a small arsenal of weapons. Among them was a small '''[[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]''', which he kept contained up his right sleeve. When fellow Jedi [[Laranth Tarak]] found him the two quickly drew their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], Jax remarked that had they fired it wouldn't have been a lonely death.<ref name="CNI:JT" /> Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|ambush]] near the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], Jax Pavan escaped the crashing [[Far Ranger]] with only his [[Jax Pavan's third lightsaber|third lightsaber]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] old [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]], his [[Miisai|miisai tree]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[SD41263.I]].<ref name="Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
